prompt:
Challenge C088-CH2: Membranes in dairy plants foul quickly and need cleaning every week.
Detail: At two dairy plants we service — one near Temerin, one outside

content.text: {"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"Cleaning protocols for ultrafiltration membranes fouled with dairy process streams were evaluated, showing that sodium hydroxide achieved flux recovery of 93.1% while sodium hydroxide with hypochlorite achieved 97.4% but reduced membrane lifetime by approximately 18% after 30 cleaning cycles.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-03378","field":"abstract","quote":"Three laboratory-scale cleaning protocols were evaluated for polyethersulphone and ceramic ultrafiltration membranes fouled with skim milk and cottage cheese whey streams"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-03378","field":"abstract","quote":"Protocol B achieved the highest PWFR of 97.4% for polyethersulphone membranes but reduced membrane lifetime by approximately 18% after 30 cleaning cycles"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-03378","field":"abstract","quote":"Protocol C preserved membrane integrity better and achieved PWFR of 93.1%"}]}]}
